context.content_translation:
来自东京的营销团队本周来访，并将 ---- 使用 A 会议室。
A. occasions
B. occasion
C. occasionally
D. occasional

items.question: The marketing team from Tokyo is visiting this week and will ---- be using Conference Room A
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“occasionally”代入题干后为“The marketing team from Tokyo is visiting this week and will occasionally be using Conference Room A”。选择理由：该项的词性或动词形态符合句法位置，同时与上下文语义搭配自然。正确答案：C（occasionally）。
